title: AI-SDLC TrustedReviewers
description: Shape of .ai-sdlc/trusted-reviewers.yaml (AISDLC-74, AISDLC-593, RFC-0043): the operator signing-key allowlist that CI verifies review attestations against, plus the optional author allowlist. Validated by `ai-sdlc doctor` (AISDLC-582) after the YAML is parsed. The file has no apiVersion/kind envelope.

reviewers.description: Trusted signing keys. Historical entries with `type: reviewer` are inert and allowed.

ciOnly.description: True marks a key whose private half lives only in a protected CI environment (AISDLC-593).

allowlist.description: RFC-0043 author allowlist read by the trust classifier.
